After the numeral «семь» (seven) the counted noun takes the genitive plural.
The preposition «из» (from) governs the genitive case.
The genitive case expresses possession ('king of Moab').

cases.sentence: Не успокоится он, пока не пожрет ___
cases.explain: The transitive verb «пожрёт» (devours) takes a direct object in the accusative case.
The verb «умру» (I will die) takes the instrumental to express the manner of dying.

cases.sentence: Вернись к ___ и передай ему это
cases.explain: The preposition «к» (to/toward) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Со скальных ___ я на них смотрю
cases.explain: The preposition «со» (from) governs the genitive case.

reading.ru: И он ушел на голую вершину.
reading.question: Where did Balaam go to meet God?
reading.explain: The text says he went off to a bare height.

reading.ru: Валаак сделал, как сказал Валаам, и они вдвоем принесли на каждом жертвеннике по быку и барану.
reading.question: What did they offer on each altar?
reading.explain: The text says they offered a bull and a ram on every altar.

reading.ru: Он отвел его на поле Цофим на вершине Фазги, построил там семь жертвенников и принес на каждом быка и барана.
reading.question: How many altars were built at the field of Zophim?
reading.explain: The text says he built seven altars there.

reading.ru: Из Арама привел меня Валак, царь Моава, от гор восточных.
reading.question: From where did Balak bring Balaam?
reading.explain: The text says Balak brought him from Aram, from the eastern mountains.

reading.ru: Он вернулся к нему и нашел его стоящим возле своих всесожжений со всеми вождями Маава.
reading.question: Whom was Balak standing with?
reading.explain: The text says he was standing by his burnt offerings with all the princes of Moab.

reading.ru: Тогда Валак сказал Валааму, не проклинай их и не благословляй.
reading.question: What did Balak finally tell Balaam?
reading.explain: The text says Balak told him neither to curse them nor to bless them.
